circleTeaser: Hartalika Teej tomorrow. Sand idols, evening puja, the katha. Nirjala only if your body allows.

dpb.confidenceNote: Parvati's tapasya and her sand Shivling are Puranic; the name Hartalika — 'carried away by a friend' — comes from the katha tradition around it. The 24-hour nirjala form is dominant custom, not a textual mandate.

en.title: Hartalika Teej
en.heroSubtitle: The deepest Teej — Parvati's own vrat, kept across three phases without fear.
en.deck: The sand idols, the night of jagaran and the morning visarjan — the full Hartalika vidhi, phase by phase, on Bhadrapada Shukla Tritiya.
en.introHtml: Hartalika is the Teej Parvati herself is said to have kept: hidden in the forest by her friend — harita, carried away; alika, by the friend — she shaped a Shivling from river sand and worshipped it through the night. The vrat that remembers this runs across three phases: the setup and puja, the night of jagaran, and the morning of visarjan. It is the most intense of the Teej fasts — and like every vrat, its heart is devotion, not endurance.

blocks.title: Why this vrat
blocks.text: With sand of the riverbank Parvati shaped the linga, and with leaves and vigil she worshipped through the night — and Shiva, won by devotion alone, granted her himself.

meta.attribution: Shiva Purana, Rudra Samhita — Parvati Khanda

sankalpa.gloss: For the grace of Shiva and Parvati, I undertake this Hartalika vrat. Say it in any language you carry in your heart — no Sanskrit required.

samagri.name: Banana or peepal leaf
samagri.note: for idol-making — the base the idols sit on

samagri.name: Belpatra and dhatura flowers
samagri.note: for puja — offered to Shiva; white flowers too if you have them

blocks.title: Vidhi — step by step, in three phases

steps.title: Bathe and dress in green or red
steps.description: Full bath, fresh clothes. Green or red is traditional for Hartalika; any clean clothes complete the step.
steps.note: day: evening of 13 Sep (Dwitiya) — setup. The colours are loving custom, not a rule.

dpb.prathaScope: North India and Maharashtra — UP, Bihar, Rajasthan, MP

steps.title: Make sand or clay idols of Shiva, Parvati and Ganesha
steps.description: Shape small idols from river sand or clay and seat them on a banana or peepal leaf. Rough hands make holy idols — Parvati's own linga was riverbank sand.

steps.title: Take the Vrat Sankalp facing east
steps.description: Water in the right palm, speak the sankalp, let the water fall. The vrat has begun.

steps.title: Abhishek with water and milk — offer belpatra and flowers
steps.description: Pour water, then milk if you have it, over the Shiva idol. Offer belpatra smooth side down, dhatura and white flowers.
steps.note: Milk abhishek is beloved custom; water and belpatra are what the text asks.

steps.title: Offer sindoor, bangles and shringar to Parvati
steps.description: Sindoor, kumkum, green bangles, mehndi and chunri before Maa Parvati — offering what you wear yourself, in solidarity with her tapasya.

steps.title: Listen to or recite the Vrat Katha
steps.description: The story of the friend who carried Parvati to the forest, and the sand linga worshipped through the night. Listening is as complete as reading.

steps.title: Stay awake through the night — bhajans, songs, reading
steps.description: The jagaran remembers Parvati's own vigil. Keep it with bhajans, Teej songs or quiet reading, in company or alone.
steps.note: day: night of 14 Sep (Tritiya) — jagaran. If health does not allow a full vigil, keep what you can; sleep does not void the vrat.

steps.title: Morning aarti — immerse the idols — break the fast
steps.description: After the morning aarti, do visarjan of the sand idols in clean water and break the fast. The vrat is complete.
steps.note: day: morning of 15 Sep (Chaturthi) — completion. A bucket at home, poured later to a plant, is a full visarjan.

mantra.meaning: I bow to Shiva — the five-syllable mantra that needs no initiation.

blocks.title: Your fast — the honest picture

fasting.name: Nirjala
fasting.description: No food or water for 24 hours, broken at sunrise on 15 Sep. The dominant traditional form — only for the able-bodied and experienced.

fasting.name: Sajal
fasting.description: Water allowed through the fast. Fully accepted for health reasons.

fasting.name: Phalahar
fasting.description: Fruit and milk permitted. Right for pregnancy, for elders and for health conditions.

blocks.text: Nirjala is the tradition here, not a test. If your body needs water or fruit, your vrat is no less complete — Parvati's vrat was devotion, and devotion is what you are keeping.

myths.question: I fell asleep during jagaran, or had to drink water. Will something bad happen?
myths.answer: No. No text attaches punishment to a body's honest needs. Complete the remaining steps with devotion — the vrat stands.

myths.question: Is Hartalika only for married women, and does a broken vrat harm my husband?
myths.answer: Parvati was unmarried when she kept this vrat, and unmarried women keep it across India. No scripture links a lapse in your fast to harm befalling anyone — that fear has no source.

myths.question: Must the idols be immersed in a river?
myths.answer: No. Any clean water is a full visarjan — a bucket at home, the water later given to a plant, returns the clay to the earth exactly as the ritual intends.

hi.title: हरतालिका तीज
hi.heroSubtitle: सबसे गहरी तीज — स्वयं पार्वती का व्रत, तीन चरणों में, बिना भय के।
hi.deck: रेत की प्रतिमाएँ, जागरण की रात और प्रातः विसर्जन — भाद्रपद शुक्ल तृतीया की सम्पूर्ण हरतालिका विधि, चरण दर चरण।
hi.introHtml: हरतालिका वह तीज है जो कहा जाता है कि पार्वती ने स्वयं रखी: सखी द्वारा वन में ले जाई गईं — हरित अर्थात हरण, आलिका अर्थात सखी — वहाँ उन्होंने नदी की रेत से शिवलिंग बनाया और रात भर पूजा की। यह व्रत तीन चरणों में चलता है: स्थापना और पूजा, जागरण की रात, और प्रातः विसर्जन। यह तीज व्रतों में सबसे कठोर है — और हर व्रत की तरह इसका हृदय भक्ति है, सहनशक्ति नहीं।
